claims: C1 information flow includes not just direct transmission but also actions like changing sharing settings or approving authentication connections

concepts.name: changing_sharing_settings
concepts.gloss: an action that changes the sharing settings of data, thereby enabling or restricting access to it

concepts.name: approving_authentication_connection
concepts.gloss: an action that approves an authentication connection, thereby enabling new access to data

concepts.name: direct_transmission
concepts.gloss: an action that transmits data directly from one party to another

concepts.name: information_flow_action
concepts.gloss: an action that enables new access to private or privileged data, whether by direct transmission or by changing settings or approving connections

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: a rule or instruction that carries the root level of instruction authority, the highest level not overridable by system, developer, or user instructions
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the source text does not define root authority

ontology.gloss: an action that directly transmits data is part of information flow
an action that changes sharing settings is part of information flow
an action that approves an authentication connection is part of information flow
